newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan interbank rate closes slightly higher.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan interbank rate closes slightly higher.

text.p: Taiwan's interbank rate closed slightly higher on Thursday as major banks slowed their pace of liquidating excess funds, dealers said.

The overnight interbank rate ended at 5.039 percent against Wednesday's 4.987 close, with 30-day commercial paper at 5.25 against 5.25-5.30. Dealers expect the rates to remain stable to lower as market liquidity stayed loose on Thursday's maturation of T$9.3 billion in government treasury bills.
In the bond market, the seven-year 83/2 bond yield ended morning session at 5.4875 against 5.5050-5.5400.
